summary: Iteration 17 - Sub-item guidance bullets on Pre Service Check, Service History panel on /new-checklist, and Date Range filter on /all-checks: ALL features verified end-to-end. Backend: 72/72 pytest passed across the 6 required test files. Frontend: sub-items render as bullets (3/2/none for sections 0/1/2), PSC submits and immediately appears in Service History with NEEDED WORK + PARTS REQUIRED, empty-history state works, /all-checks date filter with all quick-picks + note + clear buttons work, export URLs contain date_from/date_to, filenames include the dates, /all-checks?filter=today shows today-note + Show-all link that navigates to /all-checks and reveals the date inputs, detail modal renders the sub-check bullets under section names.
critical_code_review_comments: ServiceHistoryPanel: toggle DOM element (data-testid="service-history-toggle") is still rendered on machines with no history — this is fine functionally (task said 'no chevron/badge' which is visually true, the chevron icon is hidden), but tests targeting service-history-toggle presence to imply 'has history' will be misleading. Consider omitting the toggle entirely (or its testid) when records=0, or add a data-attr like data-has-history to gate assertions.

NewChecklist.js is still ~1700 lines (was flagged in iter16); adding ServiceHistoryPanel + sub_items propagation didn't shrink it. Splitting the Fault Explanation Modal + Add Machine Modal into their own files is still recommended.

AllChecksCompleted uses inline date-input onChange -> immediate refetch which triggers a request on every keystroke while the user is typing YYYY-MM-DD (visible when I typed 2001-01-01). Consider a small debounce (300ms) or an onBlur commit.

Servicing record cards on /all-checks do not have a data-testid on the row wrapper (only inner buttons). Adding data-testid="all-checks-row-<id>" would make automated tests less brittle (I had to fall back to text locator to open the detail modal).
